consent.title: Welcome to the **AI Avatar Study**
intro: My name is **Salman Ali Rafeeq**, and I am running this study as part of my research on **AI avatars in digital marketing**.
You will watch two short versions of a product video, each presented by a digitally generated (AI) presenter, and tell me what you think of them. Thank you for taking the time to help.

highlights.label: Videos
highlights.text: Two short videos, about 30 seconds each

steps.title: Quick sound check
steps.text: Play a short sound and pick the word you hear, so we know your audio works.

steps.title: A few questions about you
steps.text: Your age range, education, what you do and your online habits, over three short pages. Nothing that identifies you.

steps.title: Watch the first video
steps.text: A product video of about 30 seconds. Please watch it to the end with the sound on.

steps.title: Share your impressions
steps.text: Rate the presenter and the video. There are no right or wrong answers.

steps.title: Watch the second video and rate it
steps.text: A second version of the video, followed by the same questions.

steps.title: Compare the two
steps.text: Tell us which video worked better for you and why.

tips: This study is about the presenters, not the videos' production quality. Pay attention to how each presenter speaks and comes across.
Use headphones or turn your sound on. The videos have speech.
Find a quiet few minutes. The videos cannot be skipped or fast forwarded.
Answer with your honest first impression.
body: This study is part of a research project on how people respond to product videos presented by digitally generated (AI) presenters.
Taking part is voluntary and you can stop at any time by closing this page. We do not collect your name, email, phone number or anything else that identifies you.
You must be 18 or older to take part.
Questions or concerns: email Salman at salmanalirafeeq123@gmail.com
consent.checkbox: I am 18 or older and I agree to take part.

debrief.title: Thank you!
body: This study compared how the emotional style of an AI presenter (calm and neutral vs warm and friendly) affects trust, engagement and interest in a product.
The product was fictional, and the presenter in both videos was AI generated.
Your answers are saved anonymously. Thank you for your time.
